Status.description_en:
The status of the node. Valid values:

NOT_RUN: The node is not run.
WAIT_TIME: The node is waiting for the scheduled time, such as DueTime or CycTime.
WAIT_RESOURCE: The node is waiting for resources.
RUNNING: The node is running.
CHECKING: The node is delivered to Data Quality for data verification.
CHECKING_CONDITION: Branch condition verification is in progress.
FAILURE: The node fails to run.
SUCCESS: The node runs successfully
Status.description_zh:
任务的状态，取值如下：

NOT_RUN（未运行）
WAIT_TIME（等待定时时间DueTime或CycTime到来）
WAIT_RESOURCE（等待资源）
RUNNING（运行中）
CHECKING（下发给数据质量进行数据校检）
CHECKING_CONDITION（正在进行分支条件校检）
FAILURE（执行失败）
SUCCESS（执行成功）

TaskType.description_en:
The scheduling type of the node instance. Valid values:

NORMAL(0): Normal scheduled node. This node is scheduled on a regular basis.
MANUAL(1): Manual node. This node is not scheduled on a regular basis.
PAUSE(2): Frozen node. This node is scheduled on a regular basis, but its status is set to failed when scheduling starts.
SKIP(3): Dry-run node. This node is scheduled on a regular basis, but its status is set to successful when scheduling starts.
SKIP_UNCHOOSE(4): Unselected node in a temporary workflow. This node exists only in temporary workflows, and its status is set to successful when scheduling starts.
SKIP_CYCLE(5): Weekly or monthly node that has not reached its run cycle. This node is scheduled on a regular basis, but its status is set to successful when scheduling starts.
CONDITION_UNCHOOSE(6): Unselected downstream node. An upstream instance contains a branch (IF) node, but this downstream node is not selected by the branch node. Its status is set to dry-run.
REALTIME_DEPRECATED(7): Expired periodic instance generated in real time. The status of this type of node is set to successful
TaskType.description_zh:
任务实例的调度类型，取值如下：

NORMAL(0)：正常调度任务。该任务被日常调度。
MANUAL(1)：手动任务。该任务不会被日常调度。
PAUSE(2)：冻结任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为失败状态。
SKIP(3)：空跑任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
SKIP_UNCHOOSE(4)：临时工作流中未选择的任务，仅存在于临时工作流中，启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
SKIP_CYCLE(5)：未到运行周期的周或月任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
CONDITION_UNCHOOSE(6)：上游实例中有分支（IF）节点，但是该下游节点未被分支节点选中，直接置为空跑任务。
REALTIME_DEPRECATED(7)：实时生成的已经过期的周期实例，该类型的任务直接被置为成功状态
